# Little Cayman public moorings — DoE 2023

Public Department of Environment inventory of 65 Little Cayman mooring sites, with names, GPS coordinates, depth, pin count, aspect and source MPA designation.

## Provenance

DoE public mooring list, updated January 2023. Northing/Easting columns contain decimal latitude/longitude; coordinate strings cross-checked within 0.000001 degrees. Source datum not stated; WGS84 assumed for mapping. Depth retained in feet. MPA and mooring status are the source snapshot, not current operational guidance.

Original XLSX supplied by the user and attributed to the public DoE list. CSV and GeoJSON are derived without changing source values. GeoJSON uses longitude/latitude order; the map uses latitude/longitude.

Public availability is documented; no explicit reuse licence was assigned.

Mooring positions are reference infrastructure points, not inferred locations for ecological observations.

[DoE source page](https://doe.ky/resources/public-moorings/).
